name: Data Migration Report
description: Drush commands that generate content-mapping YAML and verify migrated Drupal 7 data against the Drupal 10/11 destination, producing HTML reports.
project_description: The Data Migration Report module helps developers and administrators validate a Drupal 7 to Drupal 10/11 migration. It ships two Drush commands: generate:content-mapping (gcm) inspects the Drupal 7 source database and writes per-entity/bundle YAML mapping files that pair each D7 field/column with its destination D10 field, and migration:test (mt) replays that mapping to compare source rows against migrated destination rows and produce a per-bundle console summary plus an HTML diff report. It supports user, node, taxonomy_term, block_custom, comment, menu_links, url_alias, file, file_private, field_collection_item and paragraphs_item source types, relying on the migrate_drupal migrate_map_* tables to correlate source and destination IDs. The source (Drupal 7) database connection is taken either from a 'migrate' database key in settings.php or from credentials entered at /admin/config/system/data-migration-report-database-credentials (stored in State).
